Verified FAQ

Cinema Tycoon questions, answered

Short answers for saves, the drive-in, rebirth, settings, cars, passes, group rewards, and code status.

What is Cinema Tycoon?

Cinema Tycoon by THEAM STUDIOS is a Roblox tycoon in which you build a movie-theater business, add cinema rooms, and explore themed theaters.

Advertisement

What should a beginner do first?

Start the original cinema, use guest-generated cash for available construction and upgrades, and keep building toward completion. Completing the first cinema is the verified route to the drive-in.

Open the beginner guide

Does Cinema Tycoon save progress?

Yes. The official experience description says tycoon progress saves so you can resume later.

How do I unlock the drive-in theater?

Complete the first cinema tycoon. The official description identifies that completion as the step that opens the drive-in theater.

See the progression roadmap

Does Cinema Tycoon have rebirths?

Yes. The game has a rebirth system and an in-game panel that explains its current benefits and drawbacks. Check that panel before confirming because exact rewards can change.

Use the rebirth checklist

Are gamepasses required?

No verified source says a pass is required for the core cinema-building route. Available passes add customization, convenience, movement effects, or faster cash generation.

Understand optional passes

Can I turn NPCs off?

Yes. The developer update log says Settings includes an NPC toggle. The developer does not document whether disabling NPCs changes earnings, so do not assume it does.

What are cars for?

Cars let you drive around the map. The vehicle store is represented by a car icon on the main interface. No verified source says cars are required to complete the cinema.

Is there a free cash boost?

The official description currently says THEAM STUDIOS group members receive a $5,000 in-game cash boost. Developers can change rewards, so check the current listing before relying on it.

Are there working Cinema Tycoon codes?

Code redemption exists, but third-party trackers disagree on current codes as of August 10, 2026. No code is marked active here without a same-day live redemption test.

Read the dated codes status
